mapper.select: select distinct p.id, p.code, p.name, p.description, p.created_at, p.updated_at from permission p inner join role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id inner join user_role ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by p.code
mapper.delete: delete rp from role_permission rp inner join role r on r.id = rp.role_id where r.code = #{roleCode}
